einzeiler: Former UK Special Forces operator Louis Tinsley on building technical clothing brand…
kurzfassung: Louis Tinsley discusses his transition from 14 years in the British military and UK Special Forces to co-founding the technical apparel brand ThruDark. He reflects on the rigorous kit modifications during his service, the steep learning curve of starting a business without prior experience, and the core values that shaped the company. The conversation highlights the parallels between military discipline and entrepreneurship, including overcoming major setbacks and scaling with integrity.
stichpunkte: Served 14 years in the British military, including eight years in UK Special Forces with the SBS
Developed an obsession with modifying military kit and equipment for extreme environments in Scotland, the jungle, and the Arctic
Conceived the idea for the technical clothing brand ThruDark during a military skydiving deployment in the Nevada desert
Secured initial seed funding of 250,000 pounds from an early investor after presenting ideas written on a borrowed whiteboard
Faced early manufacturing failures in China before partnering with designer Griffins and high-end Italian factories
Overcame a major product recall on a flagship jumper by admitting fault immediately and replacing items at personal cost
Established the brand mantra 'Endeavor Through Adversity' inspired by a conversation with actor Tom Hardy
Grew ThruDark into a successful business employing over 40 people while maintaining strict standards for authenticity and design

clips.hook: Why a special forces veteran disliked military uniformity
clips.text: The guest explains that despite enjoying military service, he disliked traditional rules and wanted the autonomy found in special operations.

clips.hook: The personal toll of elite military service
clips.text: The speaker reflects on how demanding the special forces lifestyle is, noting that it ultimately contributed to the breakdown of his first marriage.

clips.hook: Securing initial funding with a whiteboard instead of a pitch deck
clips.text: The founders describe securing hundreds of thousands of pounds in seed capital without a formal business presentation, relying instead on a photo of a whiteboard.

clips.hook: The harsh reality of running two businesses at once
clips.text: The speakers discuss the misconception that running a business is simple, explaining how they had to maintain security work to pay their bills.

clips.hook: Fixing a massive product failure by taking full responsibility
clips.text: When an early product launch suffered from severe manufacturing defects, the founders chose to replace every single item out of their own pockets.

beschreibung:
Former UK Special Forces Operator Louis Tinsley explains what it's starting a high performance clothing brand from scratch, passing the toughest military selection course in the world and how his personal philosophy helps guide one of Britain's fastest growing privately owned companies.

Louis Tinsley is a Co-Founder of ThruDark, the British high-performance technical apparel brand, and a former Operator within the Special Boat Service (SBS), the UK's maritime Special Forces unit.

In this pilot episode Louis reveals:

- The lengths it took to survive in the UK Special Forces
- The Hollywood star who helped create the ThruDark mantra
- How he risked everything on a trip to China
- What it was like meeting one of Britain's top clothing designers
- Why having a personal philosophy is important in business
Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
